title: Card 3: aam user ka tweet inbox me daalo (push), celeb ka tweet feed kholte waqt laao (pull)

boxes.title: Arpan ka inbox
lines: aam logon ke tweet ki id

callouts.red: Bieber ka tweet bhi push karte: 10 crore inbox likho?
callouts.green: Kafka ki line me 10 crore kaam, Arpan ka tweet ghanton peeche
Har feed khulne pe phir 200 logon ka jod, mehnga

callouts.red: Celebrity ke tweet pe lakhon like
callouts.green: Like ki ginti 10 tukdon me rakho (tweet123#0 .. #9), dikhate waqt jodo

callouts.red: Koi user 10,000 follower ki had pe aage-peeche hota rehta
callouts.green: Do alag had rakho (jaise 9,000 aur 11,000), taaki baar-baar push / pull na badle

callouts.red: Arpan ne 50 celeb follow kiye, 50 baar pull mehnga? Nahi, celeb cache chhota aur RAM me hai.
callouts.green: Celeb cache kitna? ~5 lakh garam tweet × 500 byte = ~250 MB

kyun: Aam log (Ravi, 200 follower) ka tweet inbox me daalo (push). Celebrity ka tweet inbox me nahi, alag cache me (pull). Arpan feed khole to apna inbox + celebs ke naye tweet, time se milao
peeche: card 2 me khabar Kafka me, workers peeche se inbox bharte
ab: Bieber ka ek tweet = 10 crore inbox, Kafka ki line ghanton atki, Arpan ka tweet peeche
agla: ab ek tweet pe crore log ek saath. DB jhel payega? (card 4)
